description: Source code for the LWM2M (Lightweight Machine to Machine) Connectivity Monitoring object implementation in Zephyr OS, defining resource IDs, state variables, object creation, and initialization functions.

methods.name: connmon_create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a single instance of the connectivity monitoring object with default resource values.

methods.name: lwm2m_connmon_init
methods.description: Initializes the connectivity monitoring object and registers it with the LWM2M engine, also auto-creates the instance.
